data.one_liner: Provides a regular expression to match all emoji symbols and sequences as per the Unicode Standard.
data.what_it_does: It offers a regular expression designed to match all emoji symbols and sequences, including textual representations of emojis according to the Unicode Standard. The package is migrated from the npm emoji-regex library.
use_when: You need to detect or extract emojis from text strings in Dart or Flutter.
You want to keep emoji-matching logic synchronized with the Unicode Standard.
avoid_when: You only need to match a very small, fixed subset of emojis.
You need complex text parsing beyond simple regular expression matching.
strengths: Matches all emoji symbols and sequences according to the Unicode Standard.
weaknesses: Provides a single feature (regular expression matching) which could also be written manually if needed.
